label: COLLECTIVE_DIVERGENCE
fix_claim: Remove the rank-0 synchronization override so every rank uses all_reduce for every gradient bucket. This fixes the step-5 mismatch where rank 0 enters reduce while ranks 1 and 2 enter all_reduce.
patch:
--- a/job/config.yaml
+++ b/job/config.yaml
@@ -11,8 +11,7 @@
 sync:
   mode: all_reduce
   warmup_steps: 5
-  per_rank:
-    0: reduce_bcast
+  per_rank: {}
 data:
   root: data
   num_samples: 96
